description: Trainer-maintained marker list for AC-1.6.5. Every string inside an authored stakeholder position (tools/expectations/overrides.json → stakeholder_context) is tested against these regular expressions; a match fails tools/expectations/stakeholder-authoring.test.mjs. Positions are fictional training-simulation content: they must never carry a real organisation, person, address, URL, calendar date or claim sourced from web research or model memory. This repository is public, so keep the list generic (shapes of real-world identifiers) rather than naming real clients here; extend it in a private location if a specific real name must be guarded.

patterns.name: url
patterns.why: web research is not a source for a position

patterns.name: corporate-suffix
patterns.why: reads as a real legal entity

patterns.name: iso-date
patterns.why: positions carry relative timing only; the manifest never contains a calendar date

patterns.name: year
patterns.why: no absolute years in fictional positions

patterns.name: real-client-claim
patterns.why: no claim that a position belongs to a real client (the fiction label 'describes no real client' is deliberately not matched)

patterns.name: web-or-memory-source
patterns.regex: \b(according to (the )?(web|internet|a search)|as reported (online|in the press)|from (my|model) memory)\b
patterns.why: source is always the page path + commit
